title: Bangsa Nyang Meulawan Tatanan Alam .
intro: Bak saboh wilayah nyang kisah jih meu-gema lam masa-masa, saboh masyarakat udep lam pemberontakan teubuka ateuh hukom-hukom kesucian. Buët-buët awaknjan that-that hana tom teudjadi sampoë djiingat sibagoë peuingat keu bandum umat manusia. Soe-soe jiwa-jiwa nyan, dan peue nasib awaknyan?
clues: Kamoe tinggai di saboh nanggroe nyang na bak rot nyang kayém jijak lé ureuëng-ureuëng nyang jak, teuma kamoe peujeuet perjalanan awaknyan jeuet keu bahaya.
Tanyoe tapeubuet buet-buet nyang hana sopan nyang hana tom jipeubuet lé soe mantong di donya-donya nyoe.
Sidroe utusan nibak kamoe geutawök kamoe mangat kamoe tinggai cara-cara kamoe, teuma kamoe tulak gobnyan dan kamoe tuntut huköman meunyoe gobnyan beutôi.
Watèë tamuë-tamuë njang lagak-lagak teuka u banda kamoë, kamoë meu-useuha keuneuk seurang awaknjan, hana kamoë teupeuë bahwa awaknjan nakeuh utusan keu peubinasa.
Tanyoe ka geupeuingat keuhai hukoman nyang that brat meunyoe tanyoe hana tapeutheun droe, teuma tanyoe tapeuhina peuingat nyan dan teutap lam desya tanyoe.
Udjeuën batèë nibak langèt djitron ateuëh kamoë, dan rumoh-rumoh kamoë ka meu-ulang-ulang, hana djitinggai sapeuë keutjuali tanda keu ureuëng njang meu-ulang-ulang.

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
